reason: I'd try the free dishes because it costs me nothing, but I already learn from YouTube, TikTok and the recipes my mum sends on LINE, all free. I won't pay ahead for dishes that don't exist yet when five free ones will last me a while.
objection: Five dishes is not much, and I can find tom yum and pad see ew on YouTube today for free. Paying by PromptPay now for something I get later feels like a gamble, even if it's only 99 baht.
would_change_my_mind: If I cook the free dishes and the 'it didn't work' button actually saves a dinner that a video couldn't, then 99 baht for 12 more dishes ready right now, not pre-ordered, would be easy.
